diagnosis.what_happened:
User or reviewer issued correction: 🧠 DETERMINISTIC ADAPTIVE CONTEXT (BOUND AT EXECUTION BOUNDARY) [Budget: ~540/600 tokens (90.0%)]
- **Target Capability**: `REGRESSION` | **Task**: `multiple_regression` | **Agent**: `statistics-agent` | **Project**: `cross-project`


⚠️ Known Pitfalls (Anti-Patterns to Avoid):
- [AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-REGRESSION-TABLE] Avoid: Consolidating regression analysis into a single unified table that lumps together R², F, beta, and t-values without separate ANOVA decomposition and correlation matrices.
  Approved Remedy: Decompose each regression reporting block into the mandatory 3 tables: Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).
- [AP-2026-MANIFEST-PATH-LABELED-AS-SEM] Avoid: Substituting manifest composite sum scores for latent variables in SEM without measurement models.
  Approved Remedy: Enforce latent variable specification (=~) using subscales or item parcels in R lavaan.
- [AP-2026-STRAY-ASTERISKS-IN-NON-CORRELATION-TABLES] Avoid: Placing asterisks (*) in non-correlation tables, including markdown italic wrapper remnants inside table cells or redundant significance stars alongside exact p-values.
  Approved Remedy: Whitelist only correlation matrix tables for asterisks; enforce pure clean Persian construct names in table headers and row labels.

💡 Relevant Active Lessons:
- [LSN-2026-THREE-TABLE-REGRESSION-STANDARD-001] Mandate: Strictly enforce the 3-Table Standard for all regression model reporting across JSON schemas, markdown narratives, and DOCX tables.
  Generalization: Never report regression models as a single consolidated row or table; always scaffold and generate Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), and Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).

⚖️ Applicable Methodology Rules & Boundary Conditions:
- No conflicting paradigms active. Follow primary statistical decision tree.
